<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Steaming Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #070504;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      touch-action: none;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="scene"></canvas>

  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

      // Respect prefers-reduced-motion
      const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;
      reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
      });

      // Viewport & Coordinate State
      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = 1;
      let scaleFactor = 1;
      let centerX = 0;
      let centerY = 0;

      // Bowl logical constants (in local unit space where bowl radius R = 220)
      const R = 220;
      const ASPECT = 0.61; // Perspective foreshortening of circular bowl opening
      const BROTH_R = 198;

      // Pointer & Interaction State
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        nx: 0,         // normalized -1..1 across screen
        ny: 0,
        smoothNx: 0,
        smoothNy: 0,
        vx: 0,         // pointer velocity
        vy: 0,
        localX: 0,     // local bowl coordinates
        localY: 0,
        inBroth: false,
        active: false,
        down: false
      };

      // Procedural Pre-computed Geometry & Particles
      const woodGrains = [];
      const potteryRings = [];
      const noodles = [];
      const oilDroplets = [];
      const sesameSeeds = [];
      const scallions = [];
      const cornKernels = [];
      const chiliThreads = [];
      const ripples = [];
      const steamPlumes = [];
      const ambientMotes = [];

      // Seeded deterministic PRNG for rich, curated procedural composition
      let seed = 421987;
      function rand() {
        seed ^= seed << 13;
        seed ^= seed >>> 17;
        seed ^= seed << 5;
        return ((seed >>> 0) / 4294967296);
      }
      function randRange(min, max) {
        return min + rand() * (max - min);
      }

      // Initialize static & dynamic elements in local bowl coordinates
      function initSceneData() {
        seed = 819273;

        // 1. Dark Shou Sugi Ban / Walnut Wood Table Grains
        woodGrains.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
          const yBase = -380 + (i / 41) * 760 + randRange(-8, 8);
          const ctrlOffset1 = randRange(-25, 25);
          const ctrlOffset2 = randRange(-25, 25);
          const alpha = randRange(0.025, 0.085);
          const thickness = randRange(1.2, 4.5);
          const warmShift = rand() > 0.5 ? 'rgba(48, 30, 18,' : 'rgba(18, 11, 7,';
          woodGrains.push({ yBase, ctrlOffset1, ctrlOffset2, alpha, thickness, warmShift });
        }

        // 2. Ceramic Bowl Exterior Throwing Rings & Speckle
        potteryRings.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
          potteryRings.push({
            t: 0.1 + (i / 18) * 0.82,
            alpha: randRange(0.04, 0.14),
            width: randRange(1, 2.6)
          });
        }

        // 3. Wavy Alkaline Ramen Noodles (submerged & emerging)
        noodles.length = 0;
        const noodleCount = 34;
        for (let i = 0; i < noodleCount; i++) {
          const startAngle = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const startDist = randRange(15, 145);
          const sx = Math.cos(startAngle) * startDist + randRange(-15, 15);
          const sy = Math.sin(startAngle) * startDist * 0.85 + 18;
          const dir = startAngle + randRange(1.4, 3.8);
          const length = randRange(110, 210);
          const waveFreq = randRange(0.065, 0.105);
          const waveAmp = randRange(6.5, 13.5);
          const phase = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const depth = i / (noodleCount - 1); // 0 = deep in broth, 1 = near surface
          const curveBend = randRange(-0.45, 0.45);
          noodles.push({
            sx, sy, dir, length, waveFreq, waveAmp, phase, depth, curveBend
          });
        }

        // 4. Chili Oil & Aromatic Rayu Droplets floating on Creamy Miso-Tahini Broth
        oilDroplets.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
          const angle = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          // Cluster droplets organically near edges and between toppings
          const distBias = Math.pow(rand(), 0.62);
          const dist = distBias * (BROTH_R - 14);
          const x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
          const y = Math.sin(angle) * dist * ASPECT;
          const r = rand() < 0.16 ? randRange(5.5, 12.5) : randRange(1.4, 5.2);
          const isChili = rand() < 0.72; // Ruby chili oil vs golden toasted sesame oil
          oilDroplets.push({
            baseX: x,
            baseY: y,
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            r: r,
            stretch: randRange(0.85, 1.2),
            rot: randRange(0, Math.PI),
            isChili,
            driftPhase: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2),
            driftSpeed: randRange(0.4, 1.1)
          });
        }

        // 5. Sweet Roasted Corn Kernels (Clustered bottom-left / left-center)
        cornKernels.length = 0;
        const cornCenterX = -82;
        const cornCenterY = 36;
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          const a = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const d = Math.pow(rand(), 0.65) * 44;
          const kx = cornCenterX + Math.cos(a) * d;
          const ky = cornCenterY + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.72;
          const rot = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const charred = rand() < 0.28; // Flame-blistered sweet corn spots
          const size = randRange(5.5, 7.6);
          cornKernels.push({ x: kx, y: ky, rot, charred, size, phase: randRange(0, 6.28) });
        }

        // 6. Freshly Sliced Green Scallions (Negi rings scattered near center & right)
        scallions.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
          const cluster = i < 18;
          const cx = cluster ? 26 + randRange(-38, 42) : randRange(-110, 110);
          const cy = cluster ? 14 + randRange(-24, 28) : randRange(-55, 65);
          const rOuter = randRange(5.5, 9.8);
          const rInner = rOuter * randRange(0.48, 0.68);
          const rot = randRange(0, Math.PI);
          const tilt = randRange(0.55, 0.82);
          const hueShift = randRange(-8, 12);
          scallions.push({
            baseX: cx,
            baseY: cy,
            x: cx,
            y: cy,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            rOuter,
            rInner,
            rot,
            tilt,
            hueShift,
            phase: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2)
          });
        }

        // 7. Toasted White & Black Sesame Seeds
        sesameSeeds.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
          const a = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const d = Math.pow(rand(), 0.7) * (BROTH_R - 22);
          const sx = Math.cos(a) * d;
          const sy = Math.sin(a) * d * ASPECT;
          const isBlack = rand() < 0.28;
          sesameSeeds.push({
            x: sx,
            y: sy,
            rot: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2),
            isBlack,
            phase: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2)
          });
        }

        // 8. Delicate Ito Togarashi (Silky Crimson Chili Threads crowning the center)
        chiliThreads.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
          const sx = 12 + randRange(-26, 26);
          const sy = 6 + randRange(-16, 16);
          const c1x = sx + randRange(-28, 28);
          const c1y = sy + randRange(-26, 12);
          const c2x = c1x + randRange(-24, 24);
          const c2y = c1y + randRange(-20, 18);
          const ex = c2x + randRange(-18, 18);
          const ey = c2y + randRange(-15, 15);
          chiliThreads.push({ sx, sy, c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, ex, ey });
        }

        // 9. Multi-layered Volumetric Steam Plumes
        steamPlumes.length = 0;
        const steamCount = 46;
        for (let i = 0; i < steamCount; i++) {
          steamPlumes.push(createSteamParticle(i / steamCount));
        }

        // 10. Warm Floating Atmospheric Dust / Heat Motes
        ambientMotes.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
          ambientMotes.push({
            x: randRange(-420, 420),
            y: randRange(-360, 220),
            r: randRange(0.8, 2.4),
            alpha: randRange(0.08, 0.35),
            speedY: randRange(6, 18),
            phase: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2),
            sway: randRange(12, 36)
          });
        }
      }

      function createSteamParticle(initialProgress) {
        const spawnAngle = randRange(0, Math.PI * 2);
        const spawnDist = Math.pow(rand(), 0.65) * (BROTH_R * 0.78);
        const originX = Math.cos(spawnAngle) * spawnDist;
        const originY = Math.sin(spawnAngle) * spawnDist * ASPECT - 6;
        return {
          originX,
          originY,
          x: originX,
          y: originY - initialProgress * 310,
          vx: 0,
          life: initialProgress,
          speed: randRange(0.14, 0.26),
          baseRadius: randRange(24, 52),
          maxRadius: randRange(85, 165),
          swayFreq: randRange(1.2, 2.6),
          swayAmp: randRange(14, 34),
          phase: randRange(0, Math.PI * 2),
          opacity: randRange(0.055, 0.125)
        };
      }

      function spawnRipple(lx, ly, strength) {
        if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
        if (ripples.length > 14) ripples.shift();
        ripples.push({
          x: lx,
          y: ly,
          r: 4,
          maxR: randRange(48, 95) * Math.min(1.4, Math.max(0.7, strength)),
          alpha: Math.min(0.42, 0.18 + strength * 0.16)
        });
      }

      // Resize Handler
      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);

        // Responsive framing: bowl sits comfortably slightly below vertical center
        // leaving lush headroom for rising curling steam plumes
        const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
        scaleFactor = (minDim / 640) * (width < 520 ? 1.06 : 0.96);
        scaleFactor = Math.max(0.42, Math.min(scaleFactor, 1.65));

        centerX = width * 0.5;
        centerY = height * 0.57;
      }

      // Pointer Events
      function updatePointer(clientX, clientY) {
        const prevX = pointer.x;
        const prevY = pointer.y;
        pointer.x = clientX;
        pointer.y = clientY;
        pointer.nx = (clientX / Math.max(1, width)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.ny = (clientY / Math.max(1, height)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.vx = clientX - prevX;
        pointer.vy = clientY - prevY;
        pointer.active = true;

        // Convert screen to local bowl coordinates (accounting for parallax tilt)
        const tiltX = pointer.smoothNx * 14;
        const tiltY = pointer.smoothNy * 9;
        const lx = (clientX - (centerX + tiltX * scaleFactor)) / scaleFactor;
        const ly = (clientY - (centerY + tiltY * scaleFactor)) / scaleFactor;
        pointer.localX = lx;
        pointer.localY = ly;

        // Check if inside elliptical broth surface (shifted slightly down inside rim: yOffset = 10)
        const brothY = ly - 10;
        const normDist = (lx * lx) / (BROTH_R * BROTH_R) + (brothY * brothY) / ((BROTH_R * ASPECT) * (BROTH_R * ASPECT));
        pointer.inBroth = normDist < 0.96;

        const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
        if (pointer.inBroth && speed > 3.5 && !prefersReducedMotion) {
          if (Math.random() < 0.38) {
            spawnRipple(lx, ly, Math.min(1.5, speed / 18));
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        pointer.down = true;
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        if (pointer.inBroth && !prefersReducedMotion) {
          spawnRipple(pointer.localX, pointer.localY, 1.35);
          // Gentle stir impulse to oil droplets & scallions
          for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
            const d = oilDroplets[i];
            const dx = d.x - pointer.localX;
            const dy = (d.y + 10) - pointer.localY;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 1;
            if (dist < 90) {
              const force = (1 - dist / 90) * 3.8;
              d.vx += (dx / dist) * force - (dy / dist) * force * 0.6;
              d.vy += (dy / dist) * force + (dx / dist) * force * 0.4;
            }
          }
        }
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
        pointer.down = false;
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        pointer.active = false;
        pointer.inBroth = false;
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

      // ============================================================================
      // DRAWING HELPERS FOR ARTISAN TOPPINGS & BOWL ARCHITECTURE
      // ============================================================================

      function drawBackgroundAndTable(time) {
        // 1. Deep Moody Izakaya / Midnight Kitchen Atmosphere
        ctx.fillStyle = '#070504';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Warm Overhead Pendant Spotlight Pool (follows pointer subtly for interactive warmth)
        const lightX = centerX + pointer.smoothNx * width * 0.08;
        const lightY = centerY - 65 * scaleFactor + pointer.smoothNy * height * 0.05;
        const maxRad = Math.max(width, height) * 0.78;

        const bgGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(lightX, lightY, 10 * scaleFactor, lightX, lightY, maxRad);
        bgGlow.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(72, 38, 16, 0.46)');
        bgGlow.addColorStop(0.28, 'rgba(42, 21, 10, 0.28)');
        bgGlow.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(18, 10, 6, 0.14)');
        bgGlow.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(5, 3, 3, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = bgGlow;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Back-lit Steam Catch-light Halo above the bowl
        const steamHaloY = centerY - 145 * scaleFactor;
        const steamHalo = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightX, steamHaloY, 15 * scaleFactor,
          lightX, steamHaloY, 290 * scaleFactor
        );
        const breath = prefersReducedMotion ? 1 : 0.94 + Math.sin(time * 1.1) * 0.06;
        steamHalo.addColorStop(0.0, `rgba(218, 132, 62, ${0.14 * breath})`);
        steamHalo.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(130, 65, 25, ${0.065 * breath})`);
        steamHalo.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = steamHalo;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // 2. Dark Charred Walnut Table Surface in perspective
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(centerX - pointer.smoothNx * 8 * scaleFactor, centerY - pointer.smoothNy * 5 * scaleFactor);
        ctx.scale(scaleFactor, scaleFactor);

        // Subtle horizon falloff behind the bowl
        const tableHorizonY = -125;
        const tableGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tableHorizonY, 0, 420);
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10, 7, 5, 0)');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(22, 14, 9, 0.55)');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(30, 18, 11, 0.72)');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12, 7, 5, 0.92)');
        ctx.fillStyle = tableGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(-1200, tableHorizonY, 2400, 650);

        // Wood grain curves
        for (let i = 0; i < woodGrains.length; i++) {
          const g = woodGrains[i];
          if (g.yBase < tableHorizonY + 10) continue;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-1100, g.yBase);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(
            -360, g.yBase + g.ctrlOffset1,
            360, g.yBase + g.ctrlOffset2,
            1100, g.yBase + g.ctrlOffset1 * 0.5
          );
          ctx.strokeStyle = `${g.warmShift}${g.alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = g.thickness;
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Warm bounced amber reflection on the tabletop around the bowl base
        const tableReflect = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          pointer.smoothNx * 18, 128, 30,
          pointer.smoothNx * 18, 132, 310
        );
        tableReflect.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(145, 72, 24, 0.22)');
        tableReflect.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(75, 35, 12, 0.09)');
        tableReflect.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = tableReflect;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 132, 320, 135, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Woven Bamboo / Dark Slate Coaster Mat under the ceramic foot
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(0, 132);
        // Mat shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(4, 8, 178, 76, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Mat body (rounded diamond / organic oval slate)
        const matGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-170, -50, 170, 60);
        matGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e1713');
        matGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#15100d');
        matGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d0907');
        ctx.fillStyle = matGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 174, 73, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Subtle bamboo slats texture clipped to mat
        ctx.clip();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 175, 0.045)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        for (let sy = -72; sy <= 72; sy += 6.5) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-180, sy);
          ctx.lineTo(180, sy);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Stitching bands
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12, 8, 6, 0.75)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        [-95, 0, 95].forEach((sx) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(sx, -76);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + (sx * 0.08), 0, sx, 76);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
        ctx.restore();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawChopsticks(tiltX, tiltY) {
        // Wooden Artisan Chopsticks resting across the back-right rim / wooden hashioki
        ctx.save();
        // Slight independent parallax behind the front bowl rim
        ctx.translate(centerX + tiltX * 0.85 * scaleFactor, centerY + tiltY * 0.85 * scaleFactor);
        ctx.scale(scaleFactor, scaleFactor);

        // Small dark ceramic pebble hashioki (chopstick rest) to the upper right
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(245, 58);
        ctx.rotate(0.28);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(3, 6, 26, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        const restGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-6, -4, 2, 0, 0, 26);
        restGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a3d35');
        restGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#231c18');
        restGrad.addColorStop(1, '#120e0c');
        ctx.fillStyle = restGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 24, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Draw pair of tapered ebony/redwood chopsticks resting behind/on the upper-right edge
        const sticks = [
          { x1: 68, y1: -124, x2: 315, y2: 78, w1: 2.3, w2: 5.8 },
          { x1: 54, y1: -116, x2: 302, y2: 92, w1: 2.3, w2: 5.8 }
        ];

        sticks.forEach((s) => {
          const angle = Math.atan2(s.y2 - s.y1, s.x2 - s.x1);
          const nx = -Math.sin(angle);
          const ny = Math.cos(angle);

          // Soft shadow
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x1 + nx * s.w1 + 4, s.y1 + ny * s.w1 + 10);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x2 + nx * s.w2 + 4, s.y2 + ny * s.w2 + 12);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x2 - nx * s.w2 + 4, s.y2 - ny * s.w2 + 12);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x1 - nx * s.w1 + 4, s.y1 - ny * s.w1 + 10);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          // Warm lacquered rosewood body
          const stickGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2);
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5c341e');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b1e10');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0.82, '#24120a');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#9c6f38'); // Subtle brass collar accent
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0.86, '#1a0d08');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(1, '#140905');

          ctx.fillStyle = stickGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x1 + nx * s.w1, s.y1 + ny * s.w1);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x2 + nx * s.w2, s.y2 + ny * s.w2);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x2 - nx * s.w2, s.y2 - ny * s.w2);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x1 - nx * s.w1, s.y1 - ny * s.w1);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          // Specular rim highlight along top edge of chopstick
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 205, 155, 0.22)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.9;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x1 - nx * (s.w1 * 0.65), s.y1 - ny * (s.w1 * 0.65));
          ctx.lineTo(s.x2 - nx * (s.w2 * 0.65), s.y2 - ny * (s.w2 * 0.65));
          ctx.stroke();
        });

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawBowlExteriorAndInteriorWall() {
        const rimRy = R * ASPECT; // 220 * 0.61 = 134.2

        // 1. Deep Ambient Occlusion Shadow directly beneath the ceramic foot
        const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 128, 35, 0, 134, 195);
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.52, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68)');

      function drawNoodles(time) {
        const gentleWave = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : time * 1.15;

        for (let i = 0; i < noodles.length; i++) {
          const n = noodles[i];
          const steps = 22;
          const stepLen = n.length / steps;

          // Build wavy noodle centerline
          const pts = [];
          let curDir = n.dir;
          let cx = n.sx;
          let cy = n.sy;

          for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
            const t = s / steps;
            curDir += n.curveBend * 0.05;
            const perpX = -Math.sin(curDir);
            const perpY = Math.cos(curDir) * 0.72;
            const wave = Math.sin(s * stepLen * n.waveFreq + n.phase + gentleWave * 0.45) * n.waveAmp * Math.sin(t * Math.PI);

            // Subtle interactive buoyancy nudge near pointer
            let pushX = 0;
            let pushY = 0;
            if (pointer.inBroth && !prefersReducedMotion) {
              const dx = cx - pointer.localX;
              const dy = (cy + 13) - pointer.localY;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              if (distSq < 4200) {
                const factor = (1 - distSq / 4200) * 3.5;
                pushX = (dx / (Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1)) * factor;
                pushY = (dy / (Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1)) * factor * 0.65;
              }
            }

            pts.push({
              x: cx + perpX * wave + pushX,
              y: cy + perpY * wave + pushY
            });

            cx += Math.cos(curDir) * stepLen;
            cy += Math.sin(curDir) * stepLen * 0.66;
          }

          // Shadow / broth depth stroke
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

          const alpha = 0.35 + n.depth * 0.62;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(112, 48, 12, ${alpha * 0.55})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 6.6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y + 2);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          // Warm golden-wheat alkaline noodle body
          const rCol = Math.round(218 + n.depth * 32);
          const gCol = Math.round(158 + n.depth * 48);
          const bCol = Math.round(68 + n.depth * 46);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 4.6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          // Wet glossy broth sheen on top-layer noodles
          if (n.depth > 0.55) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 238, 195, ${(n.depth - 0.5) * 0.52})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pts[3].x, pts[3].y - 1);
            for (let s = 4; s < pts.length - 3; s++) {
              ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y - 1);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }

      function updateAndDrawSteam(time, dt) {
        ctx.save();
        // Additive / screen-like warm atmospheric blending for luminous backlit steam
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

        for (let i = 0; i < steamPlumes.length; i++) {
          const p = steamPlumes[i];

          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            p.life += p.speed * dt;
            if (p.life >= 1) {
              const fresh = createSteamParticle(0);
              Object.assign(p, fresh);
            }

            const rise = p.life * 335;
            const naturalSway = Math.sin(time * p.swayFreq + p.phase + p.life * 3.8) * p.swayAmp * Math.pow(p.life, 0.75);

            // Interactive air currents: mouse movement parts and swirls the rising steam!
            if (pointer.active) {
              const px = pointer.localX;
              const py = pointer.localY;
              const dx = (p.originX + naturalSway + p.vx) - px;
              const dy = (p.originY - rise) - py;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              const influenceR = 145;
              if (distSq < influenceR * influenceR) {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1;
                const falloff = Math.pow(1 - dist / influenceR, 1.5);
                p.vx += ((dx / dist) * 95 + pointer.vx * 2.4) * falloff * dt;
              }
            }

            // Gentle air drag on lateral velocity
            p.vx *= Math.pow(0.45, dt);

            p.x = p.originX + naturalSway + p.vx;
            p.y = p.originY - rise;
          } else {
            // Static serene sculptural steam veil for reduced-motion preference
            const rise = p.life * 280;
            const staticSway = Math.sin(p.phase + p.life * 3.2) * (p.swayAmp * 0.7) * p.life;
            p.x = p.originX + staticSway;
            p.y = p.originY - rise;
          }

          // Smooth bell-curve fade in & out along rising trajectory
          const fadeIn = Math.min(1, p.life / 0.18);
          const fadeOut = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - p.life), 1.45);
          const alpha = p.opacity * fadeIn * fadeOut;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const curR = p.baseRadius + (p.maxRadius - p.baseRadius) * Math.pow(p.life, 0.82);

          // Warm amber color near hot broth transitioning into cool pearlescent mist higher up
          const warmth = Math.max(0, 1 - p.life * 1.15);
          const rCol = Math.round(215 + warmth * 40);
          const gCol = Math.round(198 + warmth * 14);
          const bCol = Math.round(188 - warmth * 38);

          const sGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, curR * 0.08, p.x, p.y, curR);
          sGrad.addColorStop(0.0, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(0.48, `rgba(${rCol - 12}, ${gCol - 14}, ${bCol - 10}, ${alpha * 0.48})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(1.0, `rgba(${rCol - 20}, ${gCol - 20}, ${bCol - 15}, 0)`);

          ctx.fillStyle = sGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, curR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // Delicate Wispy Tendril Ribbons rising directly off the piping-hot center noodles
        const ribbonCount = 4;
        for (let r = 0; r < ribbonCount; r++) {
          const baseOff = (r - 1.5) * 44;
          const phaseShift = prefersReducedMotion ? r * 1.7 : time * 1.25 + r * 1.7;
          const windBend = pointer.smoothNx * 28;

          const ribbonGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(baseOff, 5, baseOff + windBend, -255);
          ribbonGrad.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(255, 220, 175, 0)');
          ribbonGrad.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(255, 228, 195, 0.055)');
          ribbonGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(235, 222, 210, 0.035)');
          ribbonGrad.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(215, 210, 208, 0)');

          ctx.strokeStyle = ribbonGrad;
          ctx.lineWidth = 22 + r * 5;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(baseOff, 4);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(
            baseOff + Math.sin(phaseShift) * 26, -75,
            baseOff - Math.cos(phaseShift * 0.9) * 32 + windBend * 0.5, -165,
            baseOff + Math.sin(phaseShift * 0.7 + 1) * 38 + windBend, -260
          );
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        ctx.restore();
      }

          r: 4,

      // Responsive Framing across all aspect ratios (Ultrawide, Desktop, Tablet, Portrait Mobile)
      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);

        // Total horizontal visual span of bowl + chopsticks tip (~ -250 to +300 -> 560 units)
        // Total vertical visual span of steam top to bowl coaster (~ -330 to +240 -> 570 units)
        const scaleX = (width * 0.90) / 550;
        const scaleY = (height * 0.86) / 575;
        scaleFactor = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
        scaleFactor = Math.max(0.45, Math.min(scaleFactor, 1.72));

        // Slight slight left offset (-12 units) balances the chopsticks extending on the right
        centerX = width * 0.5 - 10 * scaleFactor;
        centerY = height * 0.56;

      // Pointer & Touch Tracking
      function updatePointer(clientX, clientY) {
        const prevX = pointer.x;
        const prevY = pointer.y;
        pointer.x = clientX;
        pointer.y = clientY;
        pointer.nx = (clientX / Math.max(1, width)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.ny = (clientY / Math.max(1, height)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.vx = clientX - prevX;
        pointer.vy = clientY - prevY;
        pointer.active = true;

        const tiltX = pointer.smoothNx * 14;
        const tiltY = pointer.smoothNy * 9;
        const lx = (clientX - (centerX + tiltX * scaleFactor)) / scaleFactor;
        const ly = (clientY - (centerY + tiltY * scaleFactor)) / scaleFactor;
        pointer.localX = lx;
        pointer.localY = ly;

        const brothY = ly - BROTH_Y;
        const normDist = (lx * lx) / (BROTH_R * BROTH_R) + (brothY * brothY) / ((BROTH_R * ASPECT) * (BROTH_R * ASPECT));
        pointer.inBroth = normDist < 0.96;

        const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
        if (pointer.inBroth && speed > 3.2 && !prefersReducedMotion) {
          if (Math.random() < 0.42) {
            spawnRipple(lx, ly, Math.min(1.5, speed / 18));
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        pointer.down = true;
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        if (pointer.inBroth && !prefersReducedMotion) {
          spawnRipple(pointer.localX, pointer.localY, 1.4);
          for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
            const d = oilDroplets[i];
            const dx = d.x - pointer.localX;
            const dy = (d.y + BROTH_Y) - pointer.localY;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 1;
            if (dist < 95) {
              const force = (1 - dist / 95) * 4.0;
              d.vx += (dx / dist) * force - (dy / dist) * force * 0.55;
              d.vy += (dy / dist) * force + (dx / dist) * force * 0.4;
            }
          }
        }
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
        pointer.down = false;
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        pointer.active = false;
        pointer.inBroth = false;
      }, { passive: true });

      function drawNoodleSet(list, time) {
        const gentleWave = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : time * 1.15;

        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          const n = list[i];
          const steps = 22;
          const stepLen = n.length / steps;

          const pts = [];
          let curDir = n.dir;
          let cx = n.sx;
          let cy = n.sy;

          for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
            const t = s / steps;
            curDir += n.curveBend * 0.05;
            const perpX = -Math.sin(curDir);
            const perpY = Math.cos(curDir) * 0.72;
            const wave = Math.sin(s * stepLen * n.waveFreq + n.phase + gentleWave * 0.45) * n.waveAmp * Math.sin(t * Math.PI);

            let pushX = 0;
            let pushY = 0;
            if (pointer.inBroth && !prefersReducedMotion) {
              const dx = cx - pointer.localX;
              const dy = (cy + BROTH_Y) - pointer.localY;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              if (distSq < 4400) {
                const factor = (1 - distSq / 4400) * 3.8;
                const d = Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1;
                pushX = (dx / d) * factor;
                pushY = (dy / d) * factor * 0.65;
              }
            }

            pts.push({
              x: cx + perpX * wave + pushX,
              y: cy + perpY * wave + pushY
            });

            cx += Math.cos(curDir) * stepLen;
            cy += Math.sin(curDir) * stepLen * 0.66;
          }

          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

          const alpha = 0.38 + n.depth * 0.62;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(105, 44, 10, ${alpha * 0.58})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 6.8;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y + 2.2);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2.2);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          const rCol = Math.round(220 + n.depth * 32);
          const gCol = Math.round(160 + n.depth * 52);
          const bCol = Math.round(68 + n.depth * 52);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 4.7;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          if (n.depth > 0.62) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 244, 206, ${(n.depth - 0.52) * 0.62})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pts[3].x, pts[3].y - 1.1);
            for (let s = 4; s < pts.length - 3; s++) {
              ctx.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y - 1.1);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }

      function updateAndDrawOilDroplets(time, dt, brothRx, brothRy) {
        for (let i = 0; i < oilDroplets.length; i++) {
          const d = oilDroplets[i];

          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            const targetX = d.baseX + Math.cos(time * d.driftSpeed + d.driftPhase) * 4.5;
            const targetY = d.baseY + Math.sin(time * d.driftSpeed * 0.85 + d.driftPhase) * 2.8;

            if (pointer.inBroth) {
              const px = pointer.localX;
              const py = pointer.localY - BROTH_Y;
              const dx = d.x - px;
              const dy = d.y - py;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              if (distSq < 3600 && distSq > 0.1) {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
                const push = (1 - dist / 60) * 28 * dt;
                d.vx += (dx / dist) * push + pointer.vx * 0.018;
                d.vy += (dy / dist) * push + pointer.vy * 0.018;
              }
            }

            d.vx += (targetX - d.x) * 1.8 * dt;
            d.vy += (targetY - d.y) * 1.8 * dt;
            d.vx *= 0.92;
            d.vy *= 0.92;

            d.x += d.vx;
            d.y += d.vy;

            const norm = (d.x * d.x) / ((brothRx - 8) * (brothRx - 8)) + (d.y * d.y) / ((brothRy - 6) * (brothRy - 6));
            if (norm > 1) {
              const scale = 1 / Math.sqrt(norm);
              d.x *= scale;
              d.y *= scale;
            }
          }

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(d.x, d.y);
          ctx.rotate(d.rot);

          const rx = d.r * d.stretch;
          const ry = d.r * ASPECT * 1.15;

          if (d.isChili) {
            const chiliGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.25, -ry * 0.25, rx * 0.1, 0, 0, rx);
            chiliGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 118, 38, 0.90)');
            chiliGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(202, 36, 8, 0.84)');
            chiliGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(115, 14, 4, 0.65)');
            ctx.fillStyle = chiliGrad;

            const goldGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.25, -ry * 0.25, rx * 0.1, 0, 0, rx);

      function drawChiliThreads(time) {
        const breeze = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 1.4;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';

        for (let i = 0; i < chiliThreads.length; i++) {
          const ct = chiliThreads[i];
          const w = (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * breeze;

          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(45, 8, 2, 0.42)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(ct.sx, ct.sy + 1.5);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(ct.c1x + w * 0.5, ct.c1y + 1.5, ct.c2x + w, ct.c2y + 1.5, ct.ex + w * 1.2, ct.ey + 1.5);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.strokeStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? '#e6381c' : '#c2200c';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(ct.sx, ct.sy);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(ct.c1x + w * 0.5, ct.c1y, ct.c2x + w, ct.c2y, ct.ex + w * 1.2, ct.ey);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

      }

      function drawNoriSheets(time) {

          { x: 96, y: -58, w: 68, h: 94, rot: 0.22 + rustle, shade: 0 },
          { x: 138, y: -40, w: 66, h: 90, rot: 0.46 + rustle * 1.2, shade: 1 }
        ];

        sheets.forEach((ns) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(ns.x, ns.y);
          ctx.rotate(ns.rot);

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-ns.w / 2 + 4, -ns.h * 0.72 + 5, ns.w, ns.h * 0.78, [4, 4, 12, 12]);
          ctx.fill();

          const noriGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ns.h * 0.75, 0, ns.h * 0.12);
          if (ns.shade === 0) {
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.0, '#253020');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#151c13');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#0c100b');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(1.0, '#1e1308');
          } else {
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.0, '#2c3826');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#182116');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#0e130d');
            noriGrad.addColorStop(1.0, '#221509');

          ctx.fillStyle = noriGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-ns.w / 2, -ns.h * 0.72);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -ns.h * 0.75, ns.w / 2, -ns.h * 0.70);
          ctx.lineTo(ns.w / 2 - 4, ns.h * 0.08);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, ns.h * 0.16, -ns.w / 2 + 4, ns.h * 0.06);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.save();
          ctx.clip();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(162, 192, 136, 0.065)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
          for (let gy = -ns.h * 0.72; gy < ns.h * 0.1; gy += 5.5) {

      // VOLUMETRIC INTERACTIVE STEAM PLUMES & CURLING VAPOR WISPS
      // ============================================================================

      function updateAndDrawSteam(time, dt) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

        // 1. Soft Volumetric Steam Clouds
        for (let i = 0; i < steamPlumes.length; i++) {
          const p = steamPlumes[i];

          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            p.life += p.speed * dt;
            if (p.life >= 1) {
              Object.assign(p, createSteamParticle(0));
            }

            const rise = p.life * 335;
            const naturalSway = Math.sin(time * p.swayFreq + p.phase + p.life * 3.8) * p.swayAmp * Math.pow(p.life, 0.75);

            if (pointer.active) {
              const px = pointer.localX;
              const py = pointer.localY;
              const dx = (p.originX + naturalSway + p.vx) - px;
              const dy = (p.originY - rise) - py;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              const influenceR = 150;
              if (distSq < influenceR * influenceR) {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1;
                const falloff = Math.pow(1 - dist / influenceR, 1.5);
                p.vx += ((dx / dist) * 98 + pointer.vx * 2.5) * falloff * dt;
              }
            }

            p.vx *= Math.pow(0.45, dt);
            p.x = p.originX + naturalSway + p.vx;
            p.y = p.originY - rise;
          } else {
            const rise = p.life * 280;
            const staticSway = Math.sin(p.phase + p.life * 3.2) * (p.swayAmp * 0.7) * p.life;
            p.x = p.originX + staticSway;
            p.y = p.originY - rise;
          }

          const fadeIn = Math.min(1, p.life / 0.18);
          const fadeOut = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - p.life), 1.45);
          const alpha = p.opacity * fadeIn * fadeOut;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const curR = p.baseRadius + (p.maxRadius - p.baseRadius) * Math.pow(p.life, 0.82);

          const warmth = Math.max(0, 1 - p.life * 1.15);
          const rCol = Math.round(218 + warmth * 37);
          const gCol = Math.round(200 + warmth * 14);
          const bCol = Math.round(190 - warmth * 38);

          const sGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, curR * 0.08, p.x, p.y, curR);
          sGrad.addColorStop(0.0, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(0.48, `rgba(${rCol - 12}, ${gCol - 14}, ${bCol - 10}, ${alpha * 0.48})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(1.0, `rgba(${rCol - 20}, ${gCol - 20}, ${bCol - 15}, 0)`);

          ctx.fillStyle = sGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, curR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < steamWisps.length; i++) {
          const w = steamWisps[i];

            w.life += w.speed * dt;
            if (w.life >= 1) {

              const dx = (w.originX + w.vx) - pointer.localX;
              const dy = midY - pointer.localY;

                const d = Math.sqrt(dSq) + 1;
                const falloff = 1 - d / 135;
                w.vx += ((dx / d) * 75 + pointer.vx * 2.2) * falloff * dt;

            w.vx *= Math.pow(0.5, dt);

          const fadeIn = Math.min(1, w.life / 0.22);
          const fadeOut = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - w.life), 1.35);
          const alpha = w.opacity * fadeIn * fadeOut;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const topY = baseY - w.height * (0.45 + w.life * 0.55);

          const twinkle = prefersReducedMotion ? 0.7 : 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(time * 2.1 + m.phase);

        const vigGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          centerX, centerY - 20 * scaleFactor, Math.min(width, height) * 0.28,

        );
        vigGrad.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        vigGrad.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(4, 3, 2, 0.35)');
        vigGrad.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(3, 2, 2, 0.88)');

        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // MAIN RENDER LOOP
      // ============================================================================

      let lastTime = performance.now();

        const rawDt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
        lastTime = now;
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.001, rawDt));
        const time = now * 0.001;

        const targetNx = pointer.active ? pointer.nx : 0;
        const targetNy = pointer.active ? pointer.ny : 0;
        const lerpRate = prefersReducedMotion ? 1 : Math.min(1, dt * 5.5);
        pointer.smoothNx += (targetNx - pointer.smoothNx) * lerpRate;
        pointer.smoothNy += (targetNy - pointer.smoothNy) * lerpRate;

        pointer.vx *= 0.85;
        pointer.vy *= 0.85;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

        // 1. Atmospheric Spotlight & Charred Walnut Table
        drawBackgroundAndTable(time);

        // 2. Artisan Chopsticks & River-Stone Rest
        const bowlTiltX = pointer.smoothNx * 14;
        const bowlTiltY = pointer.smoothNy * 9;
        drawChopsticks(bowlTiltX, bowlTiltY);

        // 3. Hero Steaming Vegan Ramen Bowl (Layered back-to-front for natural 3D depth)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(centerX + bowlTiltX * scaleFactor, centerY + bowlTiltY * scaleFactor);
        ctx.scale(scaleFactor, scaleFactor);

        drawBowlExteriorAndInteriorWall();
        drawBowlBackRimAndNori(time);
        drawBrothAndContents(time, dt);
        drawBowlFrontRim();
        updateAndDrawSteam(time, dt);

        ctx.restore();

        // 4. Floating Golden Heat Motes & Atmospheric Vignette
        drawAmbientMotesAndVignette(time, dt);

        ctx.restore();

        requestAnimationFrame(render);
      }

      initSceneData();
      resize();
      requestAnimationFrame(render);
    })();

### Highlights
- **Artisan Ceramic & Setting** ([`drawBackgroundAndTable`](file:///app/index.html#L455-L553), [`drawBowlExteriorAndInteriorWall`](file:///app/index.html#L636-L788)): A hand-thrown *Kuro-Tenmoku* stoneware donburi bowl with kiln-speckled glaze, wheel-thrown ribs, and a toasted clay *kodai* foot resting on a woven dark bamboo coaster over a charred walnut tabletop, accompanied by rosewood chopsticks on a river-stone rest.
- **Appetizing Vegan Ramen Composition** ([`drawBrothAndContents`](file:///app/index.html#L849-L948)): Rich creamy miso-tahini broth with swirling clouds, submerged and emergent wavy alkaline wheat noodles, caramelized tamari-glazed crispy tofu slabs, diamond-scored seared king oyster mushroom medallions, crisp baby bok choy, flame-blistered sweet corn, seasoned *menma* bamboo shoots, roasted *nori* sheets, sliced green scallions, toasted white/black sesame seeds, *ito togarashi* chili threads, and glossy ruby *rayu* chili oil pearls.
- **Natural Motion & Mouse Interactivity** ([`updatePointer`](file:///app/index.html#L401-L433), [`updateAndDrawSteam`](file:///app/index.html#L1354-L1471)):
  - Volumetric steam clouds and curling vapor wisps rise into the warm overhead spotlight and part/swirl dynamically around cursor air currents.
  - Moving or clicking/dragging across the soup spawns broth ripples and stirs floating chili oil pearls, scallions, and noodles, while subtly shifting 3D parallax and warm spotlight reflections.
- **Responsive & Accessible**: Scales cleanly across mobile portrait, tablet, desktop, and ultrawide viewports, and honors `prefers-reduced-motion` by rendering a serene, motionless composition without particle drift or ripples.
